entries.name: Mercor
entries.summary: Connects specialists with AI training and testing work. It also helps businesses put AI programs to work.

entries.name: Snorkel AI
entries.summary: Builds specialist training data and tools to test AI. It also creates practice tasks for AI systems.

entries.name: Handshake AI
entries.summary: Brings professionals into AI training and testing work. Their expertise also shapes practice tasks for AI.

entries.name: micro1
entries.summary: Uses specialist knowledge to create AI training data and realistic practice tasks. It also tests how AI performs those tasks.

entries.name: Scale AI
entries.summary: Provides expert training data and AI testing. It also builds AI applications for businesses and governments.

entries.name: Turing
entries.summary: Uses specialist knowledge to build AI training data and practice tasks. It also helps businesses use AI in their existing work.

entries.name: Labelbox
entries.summary: Builds practice tasks and expert feedback for AI training. Its business software runs AI programs that carry out tasks.

entries.name: Prime Intellect
entries.summary: Provides computing resources and tools for teams that train and run their own AI systems.

entries.name: Abundant
entries.summary: Builds simulated tasks and training data for AI programs that carry out work.

entries.name: AfterQuery
entries.summary: Turns professional expertise into AI training data and practice tasks.

entries.name: Bespoke Labs
entries.summary: Builds realistic practice tasks for AI programs that carry out work. Its tools help teams train and test those programs.

entries.name: Polymath
entries.summary: Builds simulated software tasks that train AI to complete extended engineering work.

entries.name: Proximal
entries.summary: Turns records of human and AI work into training data. Its tests measure AI performance on demanding technical tasks.

entries.name: Trajectory Labs, PBC
entries.summary: Builds tests that look for harmful AI behavior. It also creates practice tasks for AI training.

entries.name: Refresh
entries.summary: Creates software practice tasks for AI, including Blender (software for making and animating three-dimensional scenes).

entries.name: Surge AI
entries.summary: Uses expert work to train and test AI. It also builds practice tasks for AI systems.

entries.name: Quesma
entries.summary: Examines how AI writes code to explain costs and find failures.

entries.name: Datacurve
entries.summary: Recruits experienced developers to create coding data and test AI coding tools.

entries.name: BenchFlow
entries.summary: Builds practice tasks and tests for AI programs that carry out work. It also provides tools to run those tests.

entries.name: G2i
entries.summary: Supplies experienced engineers who build AI practice tasks and training data. Their work also includes AI testing.

entries.name: A.Team
entries.summary: Places experienced engineering teams inside businesses to build and run AI systems that carry out work.

entries.name: HackerRank Bench
entries.summary: Sells software that tests developers’ skills. Its AI business also supplies coding data and practice tasks for AI.

entries.name: Pareto AI
entries.summary: Uses specialists’ judgment to create AI training data and tests.

entries.name: Ooak Data
entries.summary: Turns real business work into AI practice tasks while removing identifying details from the data.

entries.name: Elorian
entries.summary: Researches AI systems that reason from images about physical space and design.

entries.name: Terac
entries.summary: Connects verified specialists with paid research and AI training work.

entries.name: Laude Institute / Terminal-Bench
entries.summary: Funds public computing research and helps develop Terminal-Bench, which tests AI on practical computer tasks.

entries.name: Invisible Technologies
entries.summary: Combines expert data and AI testing with software that helps businesses automate their work.

entries.name: Toloka
entries.summary: Uses specialist work to create training data and test AI. It also builds practice tasks for AI systems.

entries.name: Prolific
entries.summary: Connects researchers and AI teams with verified participants who are paid to provide feedback.

entries.name: AIXI Labs
entries.summary: Studies the mathematics behind AI decision-making and ways to reduce AI risks.

entries.name: Appen
entries.summary: Uses people to prepare and check AI training data. Its work includes speech data and AI programs that act in the physical world.

entries.name: Giskard
entries.summary: Tests business AI software for security weaknesses and unreliable answers.

entries.name: Alinia AI
entries.summary: Builds software that checks business AI against company rules and legal requirements.

entries.name: APTO
entries.summary: Creates AI training data with specialist workers and its harBest software.

entries.name: RWS / TrainAI
entries.summary: Prepares AI training data in many languages. Specialists also review AI answers and test systems for harmful behavior.

entries.name: iMerit / EXL
entries.summary: Combines specialist workers and software to prepare AI training data and test AI systems.

entries.name: Sama
entries.summary: Uses people to label and check training data. It also tests AI performance on image and other data.

entries.name: TaskUs
products: Digital customer experience and Trust & Safety
entries.summary: Runs customer support and content safety services for other businesses. Its AI work supplies training data and tests AI systems.
